description: Export the Part Studio as STL, for 3D printing. The file is in millimetres by default, which is what slicers assume; STL carries no unit, so only change `units` if the consumer expects otherwise. Measure the model before exporting it.

ascii.description: Write ASCII STL instead of binary.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

out.description: Output file path (default onshape-<timestamp>.stl in the output directory).

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_export_stl
title: Export STL
